caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden object with a cylindrical upper part and a tapering lower end, resembling a tool or container, placed against a plain light beige background. The wood is rendered in shades of brown, with visible texture and grain details. Attached to the object is a long, dark greenish strap that is looped and curled on the surface. The strap includes a metallic buckle and evenly spaced holes along its length. The entire composition is centered in the image, and there is no additional context or background scenery provided. The artist's signature appears in the lower right area of the drawing.
title: Zoar Whetstone Case
